description: CRA IAM mapping: Layer 1 (survey profile → applicable CRA requirements) and Layer 2 (CRA requirement → framework controls). Companion to docs/survey-source.md and the determination survey. Layer 2 clause references to NIST SP 800-63B, ISO/IEC 15408 (CC), and other standards are project-authored cross-mappings for discussion; they are not official ENISA or standards-body crosswalks.

applicability_values.violation: Requirement violated / in breach for this profile (VIOLATION)

notes: B_HYBRID: manufacturer layer treated as B-FULL scope for applicability; underlying IdP as B-3P (assembly may union controls).
A_B: hybrid local + remote IAM; applicability row is merged from A and B_FULL (union for compliance scope).
Paid standards: only references and original explanatory text; no reproduced standard wording.
